$description: The Kuiper Design System's dark scheme.

primitive.$description: The named colours. Parts never read a primitive; a role names one.

radius.$description: The corner radius, in px. The CSS writes it in rem.

case.$description: The case radius: every corner a part draws.

spacing.$description: The spacing atom and the ladder of steps built from it, in px. The CSS writes them in rem.

atom.$description: One spacing step. Every ladder step is a whole number of atoms.

ladder.$description: The steps a layout uses, named by their count of atoms, as Tailwind's spacing classes are.

font.$description: The type: the three families, the size scale and its line heights, tracking, weights and leading.

family.$description: The three font stacks, most preferred first. Each family's extension names the package and the registry item that load it.

sans.$description: The body and interface face, Geist.

heading.$description: The headings' face, IBM Plex Sans.

size.$description: The text sizes, in px. The CSS writes them in rem, as Tailwind's text-* steps.

line-height.$description: Each text size's line height, a multiple of the size, named by its step.

tracking.$description: Letter spacing, in em of the text it sits in. Each is 0, the font's own spacing.

display.$description: The display letter spacing, in em.

section.$description: The section letter spacing, in em.

eyebrow.$description: The eyebrow letter spacing, in em.

mark.$description: The mark letter spacing, in em.

weight.$description: The font weights the parts use.

leading.$description: Line heights with a name, a multiple of the text size.

motion.$description: The two motion budgets, in ms, the entrance's easing, and the mark's entrance as shares of its budget.

entrance.$description: The mark's entrance: the four dots docking.

micro.$description: A response: a fade in or out, a hover reveal.

ease-entrance.$description: The entrance's and the micro budget's easing.

entrance-dot.$description: One dot's share of the entrance budget.

entrance-start.$description: The first dot's delay, as a share of the budget.

entrance-stagger.$description: The delay between dots, as a share of the budget.

mark.$description: The mark's geometry, in em of the text it sits in, and the lockup's scale.

gap.$description: The gap between dots, in em.

lockup-scale.$description: The lockup's mark, as a fraction of the word.

rise.$description: How far the mark sits above the baseline, in em.

lockup-gap.$description: The gap between the lockup's mark and its word, in em.

orbit.$description: How far a dot travels before it docks, in em.

width.$description: The hairline: borders, grooves and the elevation's edge.

focus.$description: The focus ring's width and its offset from the edge, in px.

elevation.$description: A floating surface's shadow: its offset and its blur, each a step of the spacing ladder. The CSS writes them into --shadow-elevation.

expressive.$description: Expressive mode's values: the display type, its motion, its sizes, the stage's gutter and the glass's blur. Every one is on :root in both modes.

display.$description: Expressive mode's display type: its family and the four steps.

family.$description: The display face: the heading family. A subtree that sets the variable again changes every display line in it.

display.$description: The display step: a hero's headline.

size.$description: The step's fluid size: min and max in px, preferred in vw. The CSS writes clamp(min, preferred, max), its ends in rem.

preferred.$description: The preferred size, in vw of the viewport.

line-height.$description: The step's line height, a multiple of its size.

tracking.$description: The step's letter spacing, in em.

weight.$description: The step's weight, written into its type-* utility.

section.$description: The section step: a section's headline on a stage.

size.$description: The step's fluid size: min and max in px, preferred in vw. The CSS writes clamp(min, preferred, max), its ends in rem.

preferred.$description: The preferred size, in vw of the viewport.

line-height.$description: The step's line height, a multiple of its size.

tracking.$description: The step's letter spacing, in em.

weight.$description: The step's weight, written into its type-* utility.

proof.$description: The proof step: a large figure, set in tabular numbers.

size.$description: The step's fluid size: min and max in px, preferred in vw. The CSS writes clamp(min, preferred, max), its ends in rem.

preferred.$description: The preferred size, in vw of the viewport.

line-height.$description: The step's line height, a multiple of its size.

tracking.$description: The step's letter spacing, in em.

weight.$description: The step's weight, written into its type-* utility.

poster.$description: The poster step, for launches only.

size.$description: The step's fluid size: min and max in px, preferred in vw. The CSS writes clamp(min, preferred, max), its ends in rem.

preferred.$description: The preferred size, in vw of the viewport.

line-height.$description: The step's line height, a multiple of its size.

tracking.$description: The step's letter spacing, in em.

weight.$description: The step's weight, written into its type-* utility.

motion.$description: Expressive mode's durations, in ms, its standard easing, the press's scale and the spring the mark's dots dock on.

reveal.$description: A reveal, such as the glass's lit rim.

fill.$description: A fill: a meter or a progress bar.

press-scale.$description: How far an action shrinks under the finger, a scale of 1 or less.

spring.$description: The damped spring the mark's dots dock on: its damping ratio, how close it settles, and how many samples draw it. The CSS writes it as a linear() easing.

damping-ratio.$description: The damping ratio, below 1: the spring overshoots once.

settle.$description: The fraction within which the spring has settled.

samples.$description: The number of samples in the linear() easing.

light.$description: How long the glass's rim stays lit after the pointer stops.

size.$description: Expressive mode's sizes, in px: the sticky bar, the two actions and a track. The CSS writes them in rem.

track.$description: A track's thickness: a meter or a progress bar.

gutter.$description: The stage's side gutter: min and max in px, preferred in vw. The CSS writes clamp(min, preferred, max), its ends in rem.

preferred.$description: The preferred size, in vw of the viewport.

glass-blur.$description: The glass's frost, the same in both schemes.

code.$description: Code's highlight slots. Each names a role, so the scheme switch carries through.

text.$description: Everything no other role names: identifiers, punctuation.

function.$description: Function and method names, where they are called or defined.

special.$description: Special tokens: escapes, regular expressions, substitutions.

link.$description: Links, underlined: the one style in the palette.

active-line.$description: The cursor's line in an editor.

role.$description: The jobs colours do. Parts read roles, never primitives. Each names one primitive in this scheme.

foreground.$description: Text and icons on the page's ground.

card.$description: A card's surface, one step up from the ground.

popover.$description: A popover's or a menu's surface.

popover-foreground.$description: Text in a popover or a menu.

primary.$description: The one main action: a primary button, a selected control.

primary-foreground.$description: Text and icons on the primary fill.

muted.$description: A quiet surface: a wash behind a group.

accent.$description: A hovered or highlighted row in a list or a menu.

destructive.$description: Error text and the outline of a control in error.

border.$description: The hairline around cards, tables and controls.

input.$description: The edge of a text field.

chart-1.$description: The first series in a chart.

chart-2.$description: The second series in a chart.

chart-3.$description: The third series in a chart.

chart-4.$description: The fourth series in a chart.

chart-5.$description: The fifth series in a chart, a neutral.

sidebar-primary-foreground.$description: Text on the sidebar's current item.

sidebar-accent.$description: A hovered row in the sidebar.

sidebar-accent-foreground.$description: Text on a hovered sidebar row.

sidebar-ring.$description: The focus ring in the sidebar.

destructive-fill.$description: The fill of a destructive button or badge.

success-fill.$description: The fill of a success badge or status.

caution.$description: The fill of a caution badge or status, the brand yellow.

caution-text.$description: Caution text, on the page's ground.

raised.$description: The most raised surface, above a card.

mark-1.$description: The mark's first dot, top left: blue.

mark-2.$description: The mark's second dot, top right: red.

mark-3.$description: The mark's third dot, bottom left: yellow.

mark-4.$description: The mark's fourth dot, bottom right: green.

groove-line.$description: The dark half of a groove, the line between rows.

groove-light.$description: The light half of a groove, clear in this palette.

elevation-line.$description: The edge of a raised surface that floats.

elevation-shadow.$description: The shadow under a floating surface, clear in this palette.

scrim.$description: The veil behind a dialog or a sheet.

syntax-blue.$description: Code's blue: functions, links and changed lines.

syntax-green.$description: Code's green: strings and inserted lines.

syntax-plum.$description: Code's plum: meta, such as decorators and directives.

syntax-red.$description: Code's red: special tokens and deleted lines.

syntax-active-line.$description: The line the cursor is on, in an editor.

field.$description: Expressive mode's four colour fields, each a fill and its legend, the one colour measured on it.

field-1.$description: The first field: its fill and its legend.

legend.$description: Text, links and the ring on the field.

field-2.$description: The second field: its fill and its legend.

legend.$description: Text, links and the ring on the field.

field-3.$description: The third field: its fill and its legend.

legend.$description: Text, links and the ring on the field.

field-4.$description: The fourth field: its fill and its legend.

legend.$description: Text, links and the ring on the field.

glass.$description: Expressive mode's liquid glass: its frosted tint, the lit rim, the edge, the opaque fallback, the pointer's light and the shadow.

tint.$description: The frosted tint over what lies behind.

rim.$description: The inner highlight along the top edge.

fallback.$description: The opaque ground where blur is unsupported, under reduced transparency, and under forced colours.

light.$description: The rim's light where the pointer is.

shadow.$description: The glass's two shadow layers' colours: a near line under it and a far fall-off. The CSS writes them into --glass-shadow.

expressive-mark.$description: The mark's four dots on a dark expressive ground: the lifted four. The dark scheme's product screens keep paper, the roles mark-1 to mark-4.

mark-1.$description: The mark's first dot on a dark expressive ground.

mark-2.$description: The mark's second dot on a dark expressive ground.

mark-3.$description: The mark's third dot on a dark expressive ground.

mark-4.$description: The mark's fourth dot on a dark expressive ground.
